content.title: 2021 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute and chronic heart failure - Reviewers
content.note: For ESC Guidelines: The report below lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration conducted every January covering the previous calendar year. The calls for declaration are conducted during the period of development of these guidelines up to and including 2020.

experts.name: Altay Hakan
experts.declaration_text: Payment from healthcare industry to your department or institution or any other body for your personal services: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, etc. - Novartis : Optimal Medical treatment in HF

experts.name: Anker Stefan
